description: WebAuthn/FIDO2 assertion vectors for Roaming IRP spec §14.5a (approver.py and the JS mirror). Generated by an independent script with deterministic ECDSA (RFC 6979). `sig` is the packed b64url object; verify over SI(kind, data) with the descriptor values given (spki, rp_id, origin, be).

vectors.name: approver, tap and PIN
vectors.why: UP and UV set, BE clear

vectors.name: phone passkey, synced
vectors.why: UP, UV, BE and BS set

vectors.name: client data in another member order
high s
vectors.why: s must be at most n/2

vectors.name: approver with BE set
vectors.why: BE must equal the descriptor's be (false)

vectors.name: phone without BE while descriptor says be
packed object with an extra key
38-byte authenticator data, ED clear
vectors.why: authenticator data must be exactly 37 bytes even when no flag says extensions follow

vectors.name: client data nested 1500 deep
vectors.why: must be a clean rejection, never a crash, on every interpreter

vectors.name: explicit-curve SPKI
vectors.why: the same key with explicit curve parameters, not the named curve

vectors.name: SPKI point not on the curve
